content.value: An InP crystal has a refractive index (real part) n of 3.549 at a wavelength of 620 nm. The reflectance of the air-InP crystal surface at this wavelength is 0.317. Calculate the extinction coefficient K and the absorption coefficient α of InP at this wavelength.
